speaker: Penny
text: Oh, um, I, I can come back. Yeah, guess you're right.

speaker: Leonard
text: Don't be silly. We're neighbors. We're gonna run into each other. May as well get used to it. You used to it yet? Me neither. Oh, Sheldon seemed to think that I would be upset about you hanging out with him, but I just want you to know it's fine.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, oh good, because, um, his mother called me.

speaker: Leonard
text: His mother?

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah, she wants me to take him shopping for shoes and towels.

speaker: Leonard
text: I was gonna do that.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, well then, you, you do it.

speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, I don't wanna do it. You can do it.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, then you can take him for shoes.

speaker: Leonard
text: I just took him for shoes.

speaker: Penny
text: Well, all I know is he says they hurt his feet.

speaker: Leonard
text: Fine. Take him for shoes next Saturday.

speaker: Penny
text: Oh, no, no, no. A bunch of us from work are going to Disneyland next Saturday and Sheldon wants to come.

speaker: Leonard
text: You're taking him to Disneyland?

speaker: Penny
text: Well, he heard me making plans on the phone. Was I gonna say no?

speaker: Leonard
text: Alright. But let me know if you're gonna stuff him with junk food. I don't wanna bring home a nice dinner for him and see it go to waste.

speaker: Penny
text: We're going to Disneyland. He's gonna eat junk food.

speaker: Leonard
text: All I'm saying is, give me a heads up.

speaker: Penny
text: Okay, whatever.

speaker: Leonard
text: And don't let him go on Space Mountain after he eats. He'll say he can handle it, but I promise you'll end up with churro puke on your shoes.

speaker: Penny
text: Alright, got it. Is there anything else?

speaker: Leonard
text: Yeah, don't let Goofy near him. He'll have nightmares and I'll have to deal with it.

speaker: Penny
text: What's the problem with Goofy?

speaker: Leonard
text: Wish I knew. He's fine with Pluto.
